title: Choose the visual world
question: Safer register — pick your direction. My grounded candidates at the conventional end, plus the category standard measured against named competitors.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller — Approachable
options.lineage: ivory bitmap text on emissive black void, softened for non-coders
options.thesis: Emissive black void with one signal amber accent; readable type (not bitmap) rides clean baselines; depth is brightness and letterspacing, not jargon.
materials: four dust neutrals ash to ivory
options.viewport: A black void with clear white copy, one amber CTA button, and a gentle drift of neutral dust behind the content — nothing technical, no terminal.
options.risk: Still risks reading edgy; the copy and button must sell 'no code' unambiguously.

options.label: Editorial Dark
options.lineage: broadsheet editorial at full craft, dark register
options.thesis: Near-black ground, off-white body text, one restrained accent; serif display at hero scale, body set in a measured 65–75ch column.
options.viewport: A hero with serif display headline and a single primary button; sections below keep steady vertical rhythm, no competing elements.
options.risk: Reads like a magazine, not a builder; needs the primary action to feel like software.

options.label: Clean Slate
options.lineage: modern no-code builder at full craft
options.thesis: White ground, slate-900 text, indigo primary; geometric sans, generous negative space, every section one clear idea.
options.viewport: Hero headline over subcopy and one primary button; feature sections as single cards with steady rhythm, nothing competing for attention.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from Wix/Squarespace/Webflow at a glance.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably — measured against Wix, Squarespace, Webflow.
canonCard.viewport: Headline over subcopy and a primary button; feature cards below; the arrangement every visitor expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
